name: AHW
source: Advanced Hypersonic Weapon (Sandia SWERVE biconic glide body with improved TPS; productionized as the Common Hypersonic Glide Body). Aero per the C-HGB library entry; entry model per Acton, Science & Global Security 23 (2015): 191-219.
notes: Conical/biconic glide body of the SWERVE -> AHW -> C-HGB lineage. Blunter and lower-L/D (2.0) than the HTV-2 waverider (2.6); the production C-HGB shares these numbers (beta 15,000, L/D 2.0). Companion to the HTV-2 RV for comparing entry styles: this one defaults to equilibrium_glide_acton, i.e. Acton's explicit three-phase entry (high-AoA broadside direct-reentry at beta_S -> pull-up -> equilibrium glide), whereas HTV-2 defaults to the gentle dynamic_equilibrium_glide capture. glider_beta_entry_kg_m2 = 20 is an Acton-style entry beta_S (no published AHW fit exists; Acton only fit HTV-2, where Eq.8 gave beta_S ~ 17) and only affects the equilibrium_glide_acton path. NOTE Acton's own reading: after the pull-up the HTV-2 and AHW trajectories are 'probably quite similar'; the per-RV difference here is the entry/capture maneuver, not the glide.
